gdprPage.title: Privacy policy
gdprPage.intro: Cesta Života is a non-commercial website with spiritual content. It has no registration or forms and collects only minimal data. Here you can find what is processed, why, who has access and what rights you have under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Slovak Act No. 18/2018 Coll. The Slovak version is authoritative.
gdprPage.s1Text:
The controller is Samuel Koriťák, Bratislava, Slovakia.
Contact: cestazivota@cestazivota.sk
This website is run by a private individual, not a company.
gdprPage.s2Text: On every visit, the hosting providers and Cloudflare process the technical data needed to deliver the page and protect it against attacks: IP address, browser type and time of the request. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in running the website securely (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). These logs are kept only briefly, usually a few weeks.
gdprPage.s3Text: If you write to cestazivota@cestazivota.sk, we process your email address, name (if given) and the content of your message in order to reply (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). If you share information about your faith or other personal matters, we use it only to reply and never pass it on. We keep messages for 2 years from the last communication.
gdprPage.s4Text:
Strictly necessary (no consent needed):
- cookie-consent – remembers your choice in the banner (localStorage)
- NEXT_LOCALE – remembers the selected website language

Analytics (only with your consent):
- Umami – a visit-measurement tool run for us by Pictusweb s.r.o. on its own server (analytics.pictusweb.com). It does not use cookies, does not store your IP address and does not build visitor profiles; we only see aggregate statistics (e.g. visits per page). It starts only after you click "Accept".

Fonts are part of the website and are not loaded from Google. We do not use Google Analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.

You can withdraw consent at any time as easily as you gave it – with the button below or the "Change cookie settings" link in the footer.
gdprPage.s5Text: Videos are hosted on YouTube (Google Ireland Ltd. / Google LLC). No connection to YouTube is made until you click "Play video". After the click the video loads from youtube-nocookie.com and Google receives your IP address and browser data and may store its own cookies. Google is responsible for this processing as an independent controller (policies.google.com/privacy).
gdprPage.s6Text: The comic images on the home page are loaded from www.chick.com (Chick Publications, Inc., USA). When they are displayed, that server receives your IP address and browser data, as with a visit to any other website.
gdprPage.s7Text:
We do not sell data or share it for marketing. Only these providers have access, to the extent needed for their service:
- Pictusweb s.r.o., Nábrežná 4895/42, 940 02 Nové Zámky, Slovakia – development and operation of the website, including hosting and analytics
- Cloudflare, Inc. (USA) – website delivery and attack protection
- Titan Mail (via Hostinger) – the cestazivota@cestazivota.sk mailbox
- Google (YouTube) – only if you play a video (section 5)
- Chick Publications, Inc. – comic images (section 6)
gdprPage.s8Text: Cloudflare, Titan Mail, Google and Chick Publications are based outside the EU or have a parent company outside the EU (mainly in the USA). For services that process data on our behalf, transfers take place only with appropriate safeguards under Chapter V GDPR – the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework or the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
gdprPage.s9Text:
You have the right to access your data, have it corrected or erased, restrict processing, data portability, object to processing based on legitimate interest and withdraw consent at any time. Just write to cestazivota@cestazivota.sk – we will respond without undue delay and within 1 month at the latest.
If you believe we process your data unlawfully, you can lodge a complaint with the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic, Hraničná 12, 820 07 Bratislava 27, www.dataprotection.gov.sk, or with the supervisory authority in your EU country.
gdprPage.s10Text: We update this policy when the services we use or the way we process data change. The current version is always on this page. This version is effective from 08.10.2026.

cestaZivota.heroTitle: Believe the truth, be freed from sin and gain eternal life!
cestaZivota.heroText1: If you still don't believe in God the Father-Son-Spirit, please realize that your unbelief will not cause the end of His existence. The pride of your ego won't let you admit that it's not you who rules your life, but He has everything under control.
cestaZivota.heroVerse1: The fool says in his heart: There is no God!
cestaZivota.heroText2: Therefore give yourself a chance and read on.
cestaZivota.heroText3: God exists! Creation itself testifies about Him.
cestaZivota.heroVerse3: For what can be known about God is plain to them, because God has shown it to them. For his invisible attributes, namely, his eternal power and divine nature, have been clearly perceived, ever since the creation of the world, in the things that have been made. So they are without excuse.
cestaZivota.heroText4: God is love and that motivated Him to create humanity, including you, to have a personal relationship with you. However, through the fall of man in paradise we inherit a sinful nature that prevents this relationship.
cestaZivota.heroVerse4: For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.
cestaZivota.heroVerse5: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
cestaZivota.heroText6: God loves you so much that He let His Son be sacrificed for your sins, because
cestaZivota.heroVerse6: without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.
cestaZivota.heroVerse7: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
cestaZivota.s3Text1: If you choose to ignore His sacrifice and the chance of salvation, you will be condemned,
cestaZivota.s3Verse1: Whoever does not obey the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.
cestaZivota.s3Verse2: Whoever does not believe is condemned already, because he has not believed in the name of the only Son of God.
cestaZivota.s3Text2: Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ and you will be saved!
cestaZivota.s3Verse3: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life.
cestaZivota.s3Verse4: Whoever believes in him is not condemned.
cestaZivota.s3Ref4addVerse: God gives grace to the humble.
cestaZivota.s3Verse5: If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved. For with the heart one believes and is justified, and with the mouth one confesses and is saved.
cestaZivota.s3Text3: The Gospel doesn't mean "Believe, or you'll go to hell!" but "Believe, because that's where you're heading!"
cestaZivota.s3Verse6: Say to them: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that the wicked should turn from their ways and live.
cestaZivota.s3Text4: Repent of your sins and confess sincerely from your heart with your mouth:
cestaZivota.s3Text4a: Heavenly Father, I thank You for sending Your Son to bear the punishment for my sins.
cestaZivota.s3Text4b: I believe that Jesus died on the cross and rose from the dead on the third day and is alive.
cestaZivota.s3Text4c: I give up my previous sinful way of life.
cestaZivota.s3Text4d: I forgive everyone who has hurt me, so I hold no grudge against anyone.
cestaZivota.s3Text4e: Please forgive me of all my sins through the blood of Jesus Christ.
cestaZivota.s3Text4g: Jesus, I confess you as my Lord and Savior.
cestaZivota.s3Text4h: Please change my heart and shape my character.
cestaZivota.s5Pokrstenie: Be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, begin praying daily in your own words to maintain a living relationship with God, and read the Bible to be filled with His Word and live according to it. And regularly attend a fellowship that worships only God the Father, Jesus and the Holy Spirit.
cestaZivota.s5Precon: Why is it not enough to just formally believe and not deal with it further? Because faith without a personal relationship with Jesus is only dead religion, and faith without obedience to God's Word is hypocrisy. God will not accept such false faith and will condemn it. A dead faith will not save you!
cestaZivota.s5PanomIntro: The one you obey is your Lord.
cestaZivota.s5PanomVerse: He who says: I know Him, but does not keep His commandments, is a liar and the truth is not in him. If anyone loves the world (the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, the pride of life), the love of the Father is not in him.
cestaZivota.s5PanomAudioLink: Live with the perspective of eternity

cestaZivota.s5Zaver: I wish that you would believe the truth, which is God's Word, and thus regain the position that belongs to you.

svedkovia.heroTitle: A witness is one who had a personal experience and testifies about it
svedkovia.heroSub: Don't rely on the interpretations of an organization, go to God's Word!
svedkovia.homeTitle1: Who is the key person in God's Word for us Gentiles?
svedkovia.homeText1: Jesus Christ made salvation possible for us Gentiles through His sacrifice for our sins and gave salvation to those who believe in Him.
svedkovia.homeVerse1: And there is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved.
svedkovia.homeText3: What command did Jesus leave shortly before His ascension?
svedkovia.homeVerse4: You will be my witnesses in Jerusalem and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth.
